lines.text: The psalm asks the LORD to answer in the day of trouble and send help from the sanctuary.
It asks Him to sustain you from Sinai and remember all your gifts.
It asks Him to make all your plans succeed, and the people raise a banner in the name of our God.
The psalm says the LORD saves His anointed from His holy heaven with the saving power of His left hand.
Some trust in chariots and horses, but we trust the LORD's name, and the psalm asks Him to save the king.
